title: A ClickHouse REST API with OpenAPI docs, API keys and rate limits
outcome: Put a typed REST API in front of ClickHouse: named GET endpoints with validated params, API-key auth, rate limits, and an OpenAPI spec with live docs.

env.name: API_KEY
env.description: The API key clients send as Authorization: Bearer <key>. The demo default is demo-key-change-me; set your own.

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD
env.description: ClickHouse password (default: hypequery, the seed's password)

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE
env.description: Database holding the seed tables (default hypequery_examples)
